title: J3: Chat.mimiRoomUri and Chat.fixedMembership properties
description: JMAP has no field for the MIMI room URI and cannot tell a Group DM (fixed membership, >2 users) from a group. Recommended: read-only extension properties Chat.mimiRoomUri and Chat.fixedMembership. PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.12 is planned.
